name: GeoLooks – User IP & Location Finder
author: themelooks

sections.description:
GeoLooks – User IP & Location Finder is a lightweight WordPress plugin that detects, displays, and stores visitor geolocation information based on user IP addresses.

The plugin allows website owners to show visitor location information on the frontend using a simple shortcode while also collecting valuable visitor data for analysis and tracking purposes.

GeoLooks can automatically detect and save visitor information including IP address, country, country code, city, state, postal code, timezone, latitude, longitude, and visit time.

The plugin is lightweight, fast, beginner-friendly, and works with all WordPress themes and page builders.

Main Features

  • Detect visitor IP address
  • Display visitor geolocation information
  • Store visitor location data in database
  • Visitor tracking and analytics support
  • Show country and country code
  • Detect city, state, and region
  • Show postal/ZIP code
  • Detect timezone and local time
  • Display latitude and longitude
  • Shortcode support
  • Lightweight and optimized
  • Works with all themes
  • Compatible with page builders
  • Easy installation and setup
  • No coding required

🔗Explore US | 🔗Explore Our Plugins

Visitor Information Stored

GeoLooks can store the following visitor information:

  • IP Address
  • Country Name
  • Country Code
  • City
  • State / Region
  • Postal Code
  • Timezone
  • Local Time
  • Latitude
  • Longitude
  • Visit Date & Time

This information helps website owners better understand visitor locations and audience demographics.

Use Cases

  • Visitor geolocation tracking
  • Website audience analysis
  • Geo-targeted marketing
  • Visitor analytics
  • Country-based personalization
  • User location display
  • Regional traffic monitoring
  • Location-based content display

Shortcode

Use the shortcode below anywhere on your website:

[geolooks_user_locator]

You can use it inside:

  • Posts
  • Pages
  • Widgets
  • Gutenberg blocks
  • Elementor templates
  • Any shortcode-enabled area

External Services

GEOLooks uses a third-party API service to retrieve IP-based geolocation information. Service Name WhatsIP (https://whatsips.com). Purpose of the Service, The WhatsIP API is used to fetch geolocation details (such as country, region, city, ISP, and timezone) based on a user’s IP address. This information helps display location-based insights within the plugin. Data Sent to the Service, When enabled, the plugin sends the User IP address No personally identifiable information (PII) other than the IP address is intentionally collected or transmitted by the plugin. Data is sent only when The plugin functionality requiring IP geolocation is used.
sections.installation:
The easy way.

Go to your WordPress Dashboard. Navigate to Plugins > Add New and then search for “GeoLooks”. Click on Install and then Activate the Plugin.

That’s it, GeoLooks Plugin is now activated on your site!

The hard way..

Download “GeoLooks WordPress Plugin” and then extract the zip file and just drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation and then activate the Plugin from Plugins page.
sections.faq:
Is GeoLooks compatible with the latest WordPress version?

Yes, GeoLooks is compatible with the latest version of WordPress.

Does the plugin require coding knowledge?

No. You only need to use the shortcode.

Can I use it with Elementor or other page builders?

Yes. GeoLooks works with Elementor and all major page builders.

Does the plugin slow down my website?

No. GeoLooks is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Can I display user location on any page?

Yes. Simply place the shortcode where you want the information to appear.
